scripts.local:start: npm run db:start && npm run infra:start
scripts.local:stop: npm run infra:stop && npm run db:stop
scripts.worker:local: npm run build --workspace=@atelier-aurelia/workflows && node tools/run-with-env.mjs node packages/workflows/dist/workflows/src/local-runner.js
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs tests/aws/*.test.mjs && npm run test:unit && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:coverage: node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=80 --test-coverage-functions=80 --test-coverage-branches=80 tests/*.test.mjs tests/aws/*.test.mjs && vitest run --coverage && npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: eslint tests eslint.config.mjs tools && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
